pages.text: The Pulverizer's full menu — see if your favorite "dust" is here:$(li)Akaishi Dust$(li)Coal Dust$(li)Iron Dust$(li)Copper Dust$(li)Gold Dust$(li)Lapis Dust$(li)Diamond Dust$(li)Emerald Dust$(li)Quartz Dust$(li)Netherite Dust$(li)Obsidian Dust$(br2)Dust can be pressed back into blocks by the Compressor, and it's the base of the heat-sink chain and high-tier recipes.
